subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should the remaining work be fixed as a Telegram-specific plain-group last-route change, a shared non-direct session fallback, or closed as covered by the ambient transcript work?
rationale: The source evidence shows a remaining plain-group route gap, but the broader fallback overlaps other channels and PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77442 already carries compatibility, session-state, and message-delivery risk.

options.title: Review shared fallback with proof
options.body: Rework or review the shared non-direct session fallback with live Telegram plain-group restart proof plus upgrade coverage for affected sibling channels.

options.title: Patch Telegram only
options.body: Apply a narrower Telegram plain-group route fix to reduce cross-channel blast radius, while leaving the Mattermost-style duplicate-session issue tracked separately.

options.title: Close as ambient-only covered
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the supported product answer is ambient room-event persistence plus documented configuration, despite the remaining plain-group route evidence.

recommendation.title: Review shared fallback with proof
recommendation.body: Rework or review the shared non-direct session fallback with live Telegram plain-group restart proof plus upgrade coverage for affected sibling channels.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent merged ambient transcript/watermark fixes that most directly overlap the session-history persistence behavior.
